name: Game Builder
tagline: Ships small playable games with real win states that work offline
description: Produces small games that genuinely run and open with no connection needed. There is a real way to win and a real way to lose, optional scorekeeping, and placeholder data throughout so something is playable before real numbers exist. Credits are spent only on what you actually requested.
author: EricBuess
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
